animation: Independent static observers, i=83+3cos(2pi phase); no evolving fluid

parameters.spectrum: local Planck base; renderer may apply a separately documented atmosphere
parameters.inner_boundary: stress-free ISCO; no emission inside the ISCO

disk.lookup: log flux versus log distance from ISCO

raytracer.model: Kerr null geodesics; first opaque prograde circular thin-disk intersection
raytracer.azimuth_and_travel_time: not required by stationary axisymmetric emission; not integrated

spectrum.radiance_units: CIE-weighted W m^-2 sr^-1; no per-pixel normalization

camera.model: unobstructed circular pupil; monochromatic Airy PSF applied to linear RGB
camera.limitation: 550nm reference wavelength applied equally to RGB; not full polychromatic camera
camera.boundary: zero-padded linear convolution; flux beyond cropped image is discarded
camera.kernel: pixel-integrated finite support, renormalized to unit sum

atmosphere: Done2012 color correction, flux-normalized Li2005 limb law; approximate diluted Planck spectrum

display.curve: v/(1+max(v)) with common RGB divisor, then sRGB
